title: MediaTexture
description: One texture of a pack: its header and its levels as PNG files (xdl README §10.1). Wrap and filter are not texture data in these packs: the game sets them per draw (Gfx_SetTextureWrapMode).

$schema.description: path or URL of this schema

release.description: the release whose encoding this is

index.description: the texture's index in its release's table

format.description: GameCube CMPR/RGBA8, PC DXT1/DXT5, PS2 PSMT8 (palette, a palette PNG)/PSMCT32. Colours as stored: the GameCube's are the PC's squared (port-format §2.4)

mips.description: the header's level count (0 = one level). GameCube RGBA8 stores one level whatever it says; a PS2 PSMCT32 chain's 1x1 level is the next texture's first texel

header_0x0C.description: GameCube and PC: the header's last word (0)

clut.description: PS2 PSMT8: the CLUT (palette) index; textures sharing one must have equal palettes

clut_encoded.description: PS2 PSMT8: BLAKE2b-128 of the stored CLUT

file.description: the level's PNG, beside this file; when missing, made from the level above with a 2x2 box filter

pixels.description: BLAKE2b-128 of the RGBA8 pixels the release's data decodes to; while the PNG still decodes to it, build reuses the base's encoding

encoded.description: BLAKE2b-128 of the level's stored bytes in the base
